mapper.sql: id, public_id, user_id, title, category, device_brand, device_model, description, contact, status, assignee_id, resolution, resolved_at, closed_at, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket WHERE ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FROM ticket WHERE public_id = #{publicId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET assignee_id=#{assigneeId}, status='PROCESSING', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ticket SET status=#{toStatus}, resolution=CASE WHEN #{toStatus}='RESOLVED' THEN #{resolution} ELSE resolution END, resolved_at=CASE WHEN #{toStatus}='RESOLVED' THEN #{resolvedAt} ELSE resolved_at END, closed_at=CASE WHEN #{toStatus}='CLOSED' THEN #{closedAt} ELSE closed_at END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND deleted_at IS NULL
